151735.description: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine) is a water-soluble vitamin involved in amino acid metabolism; natural citrus aroma is a complex mixture of volatile compounds used for flavoring.
151735.benefits: Vitamin B6 supports nervous system function and metabolism; citrus aroma provides flavor enhancement
151735.risks: Vitamin B6 in excess can cause sensory neuropathy; natural citrus aroma may cause sensitization in sensitive individuals

151852.name: Apfelsaft aus Apfelsaftkonzentrat (3 %)
151852.description: Apple juice made from concentrate, used as a flavoring and sweetening ingredient in beverages.
151852.benefits: Source of natural sugars, provides flavor and some micronutrients
151852.risks: High sugar content, potential for dental caries, energy-dense

151932.name: Doğal Renklendirici (Beta Karoten)
151932.description: Natural coloring agent derived from beta-carotene, a carotenoid that provides orange-yellow color to foods.
151932.benefits: Provides color, precursor of vitamin A with antioxidant properties
151932.risks: Potential irritant or sensitizer in high concentrations, minimal concern at typical food use levels

151996.name: Hibiskusblüten-Extrakt
151996.description: Extract from hibiscus flowers (Hibiscus rosa-sinensis or Hibiscus sabdariffa), used in cosmetics and cleaning products for natural fragrance and mild acidic properties.
151996.benefits: Natural fragrance, mild antimicrobial properties, natural pH adjuster, biodegradable
151996.risks: Potential mild skin irritation or sensitization in sensitive individuals, rare allergic reactions

sources.label: ECHA general data on plant extracts and irritation potential

152018.name: Propylene Nitrate
152018.description: An organic nitrate ester compound primarily used as an energetic material or solvent; not commonly used in food or cosmetic products.
152018.risks: Inhalation toxicity, irritant, contamination risk, regulatory restriction

sources.label: PubChem Compound Summary
ECHA Substance Information
OSHA Chemical Safety Data

152181.name: Sitruunamelissauute
152181.description: Extract from lemon balm (Melissa officinalis) leaves, mainly used for flavoring or potential mild calming effects.
152181.benefits: Natural flavoring agent, potential mild anxiolytic properties
152181.risks: Possible skin sensitization, mild irritant potential in some individuals

152282.name: Vegetable Juice Concentrate [Color]
152282.description: Concentrated juice derived from various vegetables used primarily as a natural coloring agent in foods.
152282.benefits: Provides natural color, minimal nutritional contribution

152587.name: Pink Grapefruit Juice from 4% Concentrated Juice
152587.description: Juice derived from pink grapefruit, reconstituted from concentrate, primarily used for flavor and liquid content in formulations.
152587.benefits: Source of vitamin C and natural flavoring
152587.risks: Potential for citrus allergenicity, photosensitivity when ingested or topically applied in combination with UV exposure

153100.name: Antioxidants (E300)
153100.description: Ascorbic acid (vitamin C), used as an antioxidant to prevent oxidation and extend shelf life of products.
153100.benefits: Prevents oxidation, preserves product quality, essential nutrient
153100.risks: Low risk at typical use levels; rare skin irritation or hypersensitivity possible

sources.label: NIH Vitamin C Fact Sheet

153125.name: Natürliches Mineralwasser mit Kohlensäure
153125.description: Natural mineral water with added carbon dioxide for carbonation. Consumed as a beverage for hydration.
153125.benefits: Hydration, source of minerals depending on source water

153437.name: Correcteur d'acidité (E 331)
153437.description: Sodium citrate, an acidity regulator used to maintain pH in foods.
153437.risks: Rare hypersensitivity possible; generally safe for consumption

154268.name: Natural Colours (Safflower and Lemon)
154268.description: Color additives derived from safflower petals and lemon peel used to impart natural yellow to orange hues in foods and beverages.
154268.benefits: Provides natural coloring without synthetic dyes, improves product appearance
154268.risks: Potential minor sensitization in sensitive individuals, generally low risk at typical exposure levels

154415.name: Maca Root
154415.description: Edible root from Lepidium meyenii plant, traditionally consumed as food and used as a dietary supplement.
154415.benefits: Source of vitamins, minerals, and bioactive compounds, traditionally used for nutritional supplementation
154415.risks: Mild gastrointestinal discomfort possible, potential allergen for sensitive individuals, limited evidence on endocrine effects

154753.name: Full Spectrum Hemp Derived Distillate
154753.description: Extract from hemp plants containing cannabinoids including THC and CBD, used primarily for potential therapeutic and wellness applications.
154753.benefits: Cannabinoid content may offer analgesic, anxiolytic, or anti-inflammatory effects as reported in some studies
154753.risks: Potential psychoactivity due to THC content, possible drug interactions, variable cannabinoid concentrations, contamination risk from pesticides or solvents

154856.name: Correcteur d'acidité (citrates de sodium)
154856.description: Sodium citrate used as an acidity regulator in food products to control pH and improve stability and taste.
154856.benefits: Improves food stability and taste by regulating acidity
154856.risks: Excess sodium intake can contribute to hypertension in sensitive individuals

155287.name: C20-40 Acid/Polyethylene
155287.description: A synthetic polymer formed from long-chain fatty acids (C20-40) and polyethylene used as a film-forming agent or emollient in cosmetic formulations.
155287.benefits: Provides texture modification, emollient properties, and film formation in cosmetic products
155287.risks: None at typical topical use levels, low irritation potential

155774.name: Polysulfone
155774.description: A high-performance thermoplastic polymer known for thermal stability, chemical resistance, and mechanical strength, commonly used in medical devices, membranes, and filtration applications.
155774.benefits: High chemical and thermal resistance, mechanical durability, biocompatibility enabling medical use
155774.risks: Potential skin irritation from dust or particles, inhalation toxicity risk if airborne particles generated during processing, no significant ingestion toxicity as it is not used as food additive

155801.name: Ugljični dioksid
155801.description: Carbon dioxide used as a gas for carbonation in beverages and as a preservative under modified atmosphere.
155801.benefits: Carbonation enhances sensory profile and preserves freshness
155801.risks: None at typical beverage levels; rare risk of gas embolism if improperly handled industrially

sources.label: CO2 safety and uses

156459.name: Edulcorantes aspartamo y acesulfamo K
156459.description: Artificial sweeteners aspartame and acesulfame potassium used to provide sweetness without calories.
156459.benefits: Low-calorie sweetening to reduce sugar intake
156459.risks: Controversial metabolic effects, possible headache or hypersensitivity in susceptible individuals

156576.name: Konserveringsmedel (natriumbensoat)
156576.description: Sodium benzoate is a widely used preservative to inhibit microbial growth in acidic foods and beverages.
156576.benefits: Effective antimicrobial preservative to extend shelf life
156576.risks: Potential irritant at high concentrations, possible formation of benzene when combined with ascorbic acid under heat and light, minor sensitization potential

sources.label: EFSA safety assessment on benzoates

156601.name: Dextrine résistante [fibre de maïs soluble]
156601.description: Resistant dextrin is a soluble dietary fiber derived from corn starch, used to increase fiber content and improve gut health.
156601.benefits: Improves digestive health by supporting beneficial gut bacteria, soluble fiber source
156601.risks: Potential gastrointestinal discomfort at high doses

157518.name: Curcuma
157518.description: Plant-derived spice from turmeric root, used primarily for flavoring and coloring in foods.
157518.benefits: Culinary flavoring and coloring, contains curcuminoids with antioxidant properties
157518.risks: Rare allergic reactions, possible minor gastrointestinal irritation at high doses

158041.name: Local naturally carbonated spring water
158041.description: Water sourced from natural springs containing dissolved carbon dioxide, resulting in natural effervescence.
158041.benefits: Hydration, natural carbonation without added CO2

158055.name: INS 330 (Citric Acid)
158055.description: A weak organic acid commonly used as a preservative, flavoring agent, and pH adjuster in food products.
158055.benefits: Enhances flavor, preserves food by inhibiting microbial growth, regulates acidity
158055.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, potential dental enamel erosion with excessive consumption

158138.name: Zoetstof:steviolglycosiden uit stevia
158138.description: Sweetener derived from steviol glycosides, used as a non-nutritive sugar substitute.
158138.benefits: Low-calorie sweetener, does not raise blood glucose
158138.risks: Generally recognized as safe, rare hypersensitivity possible

158256.name: Natürliches schwarzes Johannisbeer-Aroma mit anderen natürlichen Aromen
158256.description: Natural black currant flavor combined with other natural flavors, may contain trace amounts of egg residues.
158256.risks: Potential allergen presence (egg), possible variability in composition, lack of full ingredient disclosure

sources.label: Food allergens and labeling considerations

158716.name: Sodium Aluminum
158716.description: A chemical compound containing sodium and aluminum often used in industrial applications and some antiperspirant formulations.
158716.risks: Irritant potential, possible neurotoxicity with high exposure, concerns about aluminum accumulation, regulatory restrictions in cosmetics in some jurisdictions

sources.label: EU Scientific Committee on Consumer Safety - Aluminium in Cosmetic Products

158780.name: Extrait d'orange
158780.description: Orange extract is obtained from orange peel or juice; commonly used as flavoring.
158780.risks: Potential for phototoxicity and skin sensitization, mild allergen

158966.name: CALCIUM DISODIUM EDTA (TO PRESERVE FRESHNESS)
158966.description: A chelating agent used as a preservative to bind metal ions and prevent oxidation in food products.
158966.benefits: Prevents metal-catalyzed oxidation, extends product shelf life
158966.risks: Minor irritation risk at high doses, generally recognized as safe at approved usage levels

sources.label: NKBI – Safety and functionality of EDTA compounds in food

159010.name: Sodium benzoate to help protect flavor sodium benzoate (to help protect flavor)
159010.description: Sodium benzoate is a preservative used to inhibit microbial growth and protect product flavor.
159010.benefits: Effective preservative prolonging shelf life and flavor stability
159010.risks: Irritation at high concentrations, potential formation of benzene with ascorbic acid under heat/light

159112.name: Calcium (naturally occurring)
159112.description: Essential mineral required for bone structure, muscle function, and nerve signaling.
159112.benefits: Supports bone health, muscle contraction, nerve transmission, blood clotting
159112.risks: Excessive intake may cause gastrointestinal discomfort, kidney stones in susceptible individuals

159527.name: Aromas naturais
159527.description: Natural flavorings derived from plant or animal sources used to impart flavor to food products.
159527.benefits: Provide flavor enhancement with sensory appeal
159527.risks: Potential allergenicity depending on source, possible trace solvent residues depending on extraction

159813.name: Natural black pepper flavour
159813.description: A flavoring derived from black pepper components, typically used to impart piquant, spicy aroma and taste in foods. Contains various volatile compounds from Piper nigrum.
159813.benefits: Flavor enhancement, culinary use to improve palatability
159813.risks: Potential mild irritation or sensitization in sensitive individuals, possible trace pesticide residues depending on source, ingestion generally safe at typical use levels

sources.label: PMC4948082 – Chemical composition and uses of black pepper
PubMed 29634792 - Safety and irritant potential of black pepper oleoresins

159908.name: Expanded Rice

sources.label: General safety of sodium citrates and orange juice

206044.name: ARÔMES IDENTIQUES AUX NATURELS
206044.description: Flavoring agents chemically identical to natural flavor compounds, used to impart desired flavors.
206044.benefits: Flavor enhancement allowing reduced natural raw material use
206044.risks: Potential for allergic reactions or sensitization in susceptible individuals, ultra-processing

sources.label: Safety and sensitization potential of flavorings

206045.name: EMULSIFIANTS: E1450
206045.description: E1450 is lactylated fatty acid esters of sorbitan, used as an emulsifier to stabilize mixtures of oil and water.
206045.benefits: Improves texture and stability of food products
206045.risks: Possible gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals, minor allergenicity reported

sources.label: Safety assessment of lactylated fatty acid esters of sorbitan

206046.name: E445; ÉDULCORANTS: E950
206046.description: E445 (Glycerol esters of wood rosin) is used as a stabilizer or emulsifier. E950 is Acesulfame K, an intense non-nutritive sweetener.
206046.risks: E445 may contain impurities; E950 possible long-term metabolic effects though considered safe at approved levels

sources.label: Safety of acesulfame potassium
Use and safety of glycerol esters of wood rosin

206047.name: E955: COLORANTS: E150d
206047.description: E955 is Sucralose, an artificial sweetener. E150d is Sulphite Ammonia Caramel, a caramel color used as a food coloring agent.
206047.benefits: Sweetness without calories, color enhancement in foods and beverages
206047.risks: Sucralose may affect gut microbiota with excessive use; caramel color E150d may contain 4-MEI a potential carcinogen but below regulatory limits

sources.label: Sucralose safety and effects
Safety evaluation of caramel color E150d

206522.name: Acqua gassata
206522.description: Carbonated water, water infused with carbon dioxide gas under pressure to create effervescence.
206522.benefits: Provides hydration with a fizzy texture, alternative to still water

206523.name: Aroma di uva bianca
206523.description: White grape flavoring agent used to impart grape aroma and taste in food and beverages. It usually consists of natural and/or synthetic flavor compounds.
206523.benefits: Enhances flavor profile of products, improves consumer acceptance
206523.risks: Potential for allergic sensitization, lack of transparency about chemical composition, possible presence of synthetic flavoring agents

sources.label: Evaluation of food flavor allergens and sensitizers

206583.name: Pramenitá minerální voda
206583.description: Naturally occurring mineral water sourced from underground springs containing various dissolved minerals.

sources.label: Mineral water and hydration benefits PMC5662928

206584.name: Extrakt z hroznové šťávy
206584.description: Concentrated extract derived from grape juice, containing sugars, phenolic compounds, and antioxidants.
206584.risks: High sugar content, potential for increased caloric intake

sources.label: Grape polyphenols and antioxidant effects PMID19956487

206755.name: Ester Calcium disodium EDTA
206755.description: A chelating agent and stabilizer commonly used in food and cosmetic products to bind metal ions, preventing oxidation and spoilage.
206755.benefits: Metal ion chelation, prevents oxidation, enhances product stability

sources.label: Safety assessment of EDTA and its salts in cosmetics and food

206879.name: Água mineral carbogasosa
206879.description: Carbonated mineral water containing dissolved minerals and carbon dioxide, used as a beverage for hydration and mineral intake.
206879.risks: Dental enamel erosion from carbonation, potential gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals

sources.label: PMID 23072814 – Effects of carbonated water on dental health
PMID 22595140 – Mineral water and hydration benefits

206880.name: Litinada e fluoretada
206880.description: Water treated with iron (litinada) and fluoride (fluoretada) to adjust mineral content for consumption or dental health.
206880.benefits: Fluoride supports dental enamel resistance, iron contributes to dietary mineral intake
206880.risks: Excess fluoride intake can cause dental fluorosis, iron at high levels may cause gastrointestinal irritation

sources.label: PMID 19516060 – Fluoride for dental health and risks
PMID 30718747 – Iron supplementation and gastrointestinal effects

207110.name: Jus d'ume abricot du Japon 12%
207110.description: Juice derived from Ume fruit (Prunus mume), also known as Japanese apricot, often used as a flavoring or acidic agent in foods and beverages.
207110.benefits: Natural flavoring, source of organic acids contributing to taste
207110.risks: Irritation if consumed in excessive amounts due to organic acid content, possible allergen in sensitive individuals

sources.label: PMC6332574 - Characterization and health properties of Prunus mume fruit

207111.name: Purée d'ume
207111.description: Puree made from Ume fruit (Prunus mume), used as a food ingredient providing flavor and acidity.
207111.benefits: Natural flavoring, source of organic acids and antioxidants
207111.risks: May cause oral or gastric irritation if consumed in large quantities due to high organic acid concentration

sources.label: PMC6332574 - Characterization and health properties of Prunus mume fruit

207166.name: Eple 4
207166.description: Likely a variant of apple fruit ingredient or concentrate used for flavoring or nutritional contribution in food products.
207166.benefits: Natural flavor, potential source of vitamins and antioxidants

207168.name: Sitron 3 %
207168.description: Lemon component at 3% concentration, typically lemon juice or lemon extract, used for flavoring and acidity regulation.
207168.benefits: Flavor enhancement, source of vitamin C
207168.risks: Acidic irritation in high amounts, dental enamel erosion if consumed excessively

207169.name: Naturlig sitrusaroma
207169.description: Natural citrus flavor derived from citrus fruit oils or extracts, used for flavoring in foods and beverages.
207169.benefits: Flavor enhancement, commonly recognized as safe for consumption
207169.risks: Potential mild skin or mucous membrane irritation or sensitization in sensitive individuals, low risk at normal ingestion levels

207249.name: Carbonated Watermelon Juice
207249.description: Juice extracted from watermelon fruit, carbonated by addition of carbon dioxide gas. Typically used as a flavored beverage ingredient.
207249.benefits: Hydration, source of natural sugars and electrolytes, refreshing flavor
207249.risks: Possible dental erosion from carbonation, minor gastrointestinal discomfort for sensitive individuals

sources.label: PMC5653053 - Effects of carbonated beverages on dental health
PMC6627848 - Nutritional and health effects of watermelon consumption
